how_desc: No technical skills needed. No downloads. Setup takes under 2 minutes.
how_step1_desc: Enter your Gmail address and a Google App Password. This is a special 16-character code from Google — not your real password. You can revoke it anytime from your Google Account.
how_step1_note: Your credentials are encrypted with AES-256 — the same standard used by banks.
how_step2_desc: Paste 3-5 examples of your real email replies. The system analyzes your writing style — your tone, greeting, sign-off, and language preference — to create a unique Tone Profile.
how_step2_note: The more samples you provide, the more accurate your AI clone becomes.
how_step3_desc: When a new email arrives, your Tone Profile is used to instantly draft a reply that sounds like you. Open your dashboard, review the draft, edit if needed, and send.
how_step3_note: You stay in full control. Nothing gets sent without your approval.

guide_subtitle: How to retrieve your App Password
guide_gmail_step1: Make sure 2-Step Verification is turned on in your Google settings.
guide_gmail_step3: Type AutoInbox as the app name and click Create.
guide_gmail_step4: Copy the 16-character code and paste it in the connect input without spaces.
guide_yahoo_step2: Scroll down and click Generate app password.
guide_yahoo_step4: Copy the 16-character code and paste it in the connect input without spaces.
trouble_desc: If you encounter "Invalid credentials", make sure your email address is correct and the 16-character code has no spaces. Also ensure you are using a generated App Password and not your personal login password.

tos_summary_text: Use AutoInbox responsibly. Don't use it for spam or illegal purposes. We provide the service "as-is" and are not liable for AI-generated content.
tos_s1_body: By creating an account or using AutoInbox, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
tos_s2_body:
AutoInbox is an AI-powered email auto-reply service that:

  • Monitors your email inbox for incoming messages (when enabled).
  • Generates draft replies using artificial intelligence based on your writing style.
  • Sends approved replies on your behalf through your own email account.
tos_s3_body:
You are responsible for:

  • Providing accurate account information.
  • Maintaining the security of your login credentials.
  • All activity that occurs under your account.
  • Reviewing AI-generated drafts before approving them for sending.
  • Ensuring your use complies with applicable laws and regulations.
tos_s4_body:
You agree NOT to use AutoInbox for:

  • Sending spam, unsolicited messages, or bulk emails.
  • Fraudulent, deceptive, or illegal communications.
  • Impersonation with malicious intent.
  • Distributing malware, phishing, or harmful content.
  • Using profanity, offensive, or inappropriate language in any text input.
  • Violating any applicable local, national, or international laws.
Profanity Policy: AutoInbox automatically filters and blocks foul, offensive, and inappropriate language across 12 languages (English, Filipino, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Indonesian, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, and Arabic). Any attempt to submit content containing profanity — including leetspeak evasion (e.g., f*ck, sh1t, @ss) — will be automatically rejected by our system.
tos_s4_highlight: Profanity Policy: AutoInbox automatically filters and blocks foul, offensive, and inappropriate language across 12 languages (English, Filipino, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Indonesian, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, and Arabic). Any attempt to submit content containing profanity — including leetspeak evasion (e.g., f*ck, sh1t, @ss) — will be automatically rejected by our system.
tos_s5_body:
AutoInbox uses Google Gemini AI to generate reply drafts. Please note:

  • AI-generated content may not always be accurate or appropriate.
  • You are responsible for reviewing and approving all drafts before they are sent.
  • AutoInbox is not liable for any consequences arising from AI-generated content that you approve and send.
  • The AI learns from the voice samples you provide — the quality of responses depends on the quality of your training data.
tos_s6_body:
• Free Plan: Includes 10 AI replies per month at no cost.
  • Paid Plans: Basic (₱499/mo) and Pro (₱999/mo) offer additional features and higher limits.
  • Payments are processed securely through PayMongo.
  • You may cancel your subscription at any time. No refunds for partial billing periods.
  • Pricing is subject to change with 30 days notice.
tos_s7_body:
We strive to maintain 99% uptime but do not guarantee uninterrupted service. AutoInbox may be temporarily unavailable due to:

  • Scheduled maintenance and updates.
  • Unexpected technical issues.
  • Third-party service outages (Google, PayMongo, hosting provider).
tos_s8_body:
AutoInbox is provided "as-is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for:

  • Lost business, revenue, or opportunities due to service interruptions.
  • Inaccurate, inappropriate, or offensive AI-generated content.

  • Any damages arising from the use or inability to use the service.

pp_summary_text: We only collect what's necessary to provide the service. We never sell your data. Your emails are encrypted with AES-256 military-grade encryption.
pp_s1_body:
When you create an account and use AutoInbox, we collect:

  • Account Information: Your name, email address, and password (hashed using bcrypt with 12 salt rounds).
  • Email Credentials: Your Gmail address and App Password, encrypted using AES-256-GCM encryption. We never store your actual Google password.
  • Email Content: Incoming email metadata (sender, subject, body) for AI processing. This data is stored locally in our encrypted database.
  • Voice Samples: Text samples you voluntarily provide to train your AI clone's writing style.
  • Usage Data: Basic analytics like message counts and feature usage.
pp_s2_body:
Your information is used exclusively to:

  • Provide AI-powered auto-reply drafts that match your writing style.
  • Monitor your inbox for incoming messages (only when you enable this feature).
  • Send approved replies on your behalf through your own email account.
  • Improve the accuracy of your AI clone over time.
pp_s3_body:
We take security seriously:

  • Encryption: All email credentials are encrypted with AES-256-GCM, the same standard used by banks and military systems.
  • Password Hashing: Account passwords are hashed using bcrypt (12 rounds). We cannot read your password.
  • HTTPS: All data in transit is encrypted via TLS/SSL.
  • Security Headers: We use Helmet.js to set strict HTTP security headers.
  • Rate Limiting: API endpoints are rate-limited to prevent abuse.
pp_s4_body:
We use the following third-party services:

  • Google Gemini AI: To generate email reply drafts. Email content is sent to Google's API for processing. See Google AI Terms.
  • PayMongo: For payment processing. We never store your payment card details. See PayMongo Privacy Policy.
  • Render: For hosting. See Render Privacy Policy.
pp_s5_body: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. You can delete your account at any time by disconnecting your email and contacting us. Upon deletion, all your data (messages, drafts, voice samples, and credentials) will be permanently removed.
pp_s6_body:
You have the right to:

  • Access your personal data stored in our system.
  • Disconnect your email at any time from the Settings page.
  • Delete your voice samples and AI profile.
  • Request complete account deletion.
pp_s7_body:
If you have questions about this privacy policy, contact us at:

Email: autoinbox1990@gmail.com
